states.DECLARED: Self-authored identity or devotion. No external proof implied.
states.ASSUMED: A mantle consciously chosen as a practice target.
states.PRACTICED: Relevant practices have been performed; no claim of mastery.
states.EARNED: A defined School gate has been passed.
states.WITNESSED: A valid artifact, peer, system, or authorized reviewer supports the defined behavior.
states.TRANSMUTED: A personal name forged from multiple legitimate roots/titles and accepted by the bearer.
states.RETIRED: Historical identity preserved but no longer actively worn.

witness_types.SELF: First-person declaration; authoritative only for self-description.
witness_types.ARTIFACT: A saved work product demonstrates the defined operation.
witness_types.PEER: Another participant attests to a specified behavior.
witness_types.SYSTEM: A deterministic or preregistered gate verified a bounded criterion.
witness_types.REVIEWER: A designated human reviewer checked the evidence.

invariants: Devotion cannot require EARNED or WITNESSED status.
AI may propose a TRANSMUTED name but cannot accept it for the bearer.
A public title must expose a boundary statement on inspection.
